title: Unsynchronized Spinlock loops
pattern: Spin-waiting on a plain boolean flag modified by another thread without volatile/atomic reads or compiler fences.
why_bad: Infinite loop hazard. The compiler can optimize the loop by loading the variable into a CPU register once, never observing changes made by other threads.
detection: Loops reading shared unsynchronized variables with no compiler fences or atomic operations in the body.
source: Paul E. McKenney, *Is Parallel Programming Hard?*, Listing 4.19.
